evidence: Publil. Sent. C 12: Cuivīs dolōrī remedium est patientia.

phrases.english: For every pain, patience is the cure.
he bore heat and cold alike

phrases.latin: Quō ūsque tandem abūtēre, Catilīna, patientiā nostrā?
phrases.english: How long, Catiline, will you go on trying our patience?

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-publilius, loci-livius), checked against the editions named there.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 23, checked against the searchable text of the book.
